_source: Response body of GET /wp-json/wc/v3/products?status=publish&_fields=id,name,price,permalink&per_page=100&page=1. The two products of the 'List all products' example at https://developer.woocommerce.com/docs/apis/rest-api/v3/products#list-all-products (a variable product with price "" and a simple product at "21.99"), reduced to the requested _fields. The test serves `body` as the response.
